objective: Estimate whether another verifier call or recurrent visit is worth its cost after a failed attempt.
context: Public failed candidate and checker code; future rescue labels are separate. Calibrated ridge readout on archived fixed-depth trajectories; exact acceptance remains verifier-owned.

steps.name: Verify archive
steps.description: Reconstruct task, checkpoint and verifier evidence.

steps.name: Observe failure
steps.description: Define what is known at the post-check decision.

steps.name: Estimate value
steps.description: Derive marginal expected benefit of further compute.

steps.name: Freeze threshold
steps.description: Specify calibration-only selection and missed-rescue bound.

steps.name: Evaluate policy
steps.description: Count saved visits, costs, missed rescues and OOD limits.

specific_questions.prompt: Compare pre-check STOP and post-check CONTINUE as different information sets; construct a case where the policies disagree.
Derive a decision rule for rescue value versus verifier cost and show how uncertainty changes defer behavior.

native_verifier: RLT postfailure_exit replay validator and independent future-rescue labels.
